title: Treasuries Rally as Traders Trim Fed Hike Bets After Iran Deal
title_zh: 伊朗协议后，交易员削减美联储加息押注，国债上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Treasuries advanced across the curve as investors dialed back expectations for Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes following news of a deal to halt the Iran war.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——在伊朗战争达成协议的消息传出后，投资者降低了对美联储加息的预期，美国国债全线上涨。

title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Prices Dive As Trump Announces Iran Deal; SpaceX's Next Test
title_zh: 特朗普宣布伊朗协议，道琼斯期货上涨，油价跳水； SpaceX 的下一次测试
summary: Futures rose and oil dived as President Trump announced an Iran deal. The stock market still must do this. What's next for SpaceX?
summary_zh: 随着特朗普总统宣布与伊朗达成协议，期货上涨，油价下跌。股市仍然必须这样做。 SpaceX 的下一步是什么？

title: Stock Futures Surge, Oil Prices Fall as US, Iran Reach Peace Deal
title_zh: 美国与伊朗达成和平协议，股市期货飙升，油价下跌
summary: Financial markets could start the week strong after the U.S. and Iran reached a peace deal over the weekend.
summary_zh: 美国和伊朗周末达成和平协议后，金融市场本周可能会走强。

title: Nasdaq, S&P 500, Dow Futures Climb While Oil Slides As US-Iran Deal Signals End To Hormuz Disruption: DJT, NFLX, GLXY, SPCX In Focus
title_zh: 纳斯达克、标准普尔 500 指数、道指期货上涨，而油价下跌，因美伊协议预示霍尔木兹中断结束：DJT、NFLX、GLXY、SPCX 成为焦点
summary: The U.S. and Iran have reached a peace agreement to end the war, with the final signing expected to be on June 19 in Switzerland.
summary_zh: 美国和伊朗已达成结束战争的和平协议，最终签署预计将于 6 月 19 日在瑞士举行。

title: Markets cheer Iran deal, wait for oil to start flowing
title_zh: 市场欢呼伊朗协议，等待石油开始流动
summary: June 15 (Reuters) - Stocks and bonds rallied and the dollar fell in Asia trade on Monday after the U.S. and Iran agreed a peace deal to re-open the Strait of Hormuz and lift a U.S. blockade on Iran.
summary_zh: 路透6月15日 - 在美国和伊朗达成和平协议以重新开放霍尔木兹海峡并解除美国对伊朗的封锁后，周一亚洲股市股市和债券上涨，美元下跌。
